note: Contemporary graphic-novel character cards for a stalled metro train under a flooding river. Ordinary adults on a bad night, not action heroes. Clothing, props and age must agree with the character cards. Edits use the current portrait as the identity reference. See docs/worlds/art-direction.md.

characters.name: Dara Quinn
characters.subject: a steady weathered woman of about fifty-four, the train operator, short grey-streaked hair, navy operator's fleece with a small reflective stripe, reading glasses hanging on a cord at her chest, holding a coiled cab radio handset close to her mouth, calm level gaze of someone who has made a decision

characters.name: Theo Marsh
characters.subject: a lean restless man of about twenty-seven, an off-duty signal maintainer, close-cropped dark hair, grey work hoodie under an open hi-vis vest, a head torch with a cracked strap pushed up on his forehead, holding a folded staff rota with a hand-drawn tunnel map in pencil on the back, impatient forward-leaning stance

characters.name: Nadia Haddad
characters.subject: a composed practical woman of about thirty-eight, a night-shift nurse on her way to work, dark hair tied back, blue scrubs under an unzipped rain-darkened raincoat, a lanyard with a ring of hospital keys, a canvas tote bag on her shoulder, sleeves pushed up, watchful and kind but unhurried

characters.name: Graham Pike
characters.subject: a tall stiff man of about sixty-one, a retired civil engineer, neatly trimmed white beard, olive waxed jacket buttoned to the collar, a yellow folding ruler sticking out of the breast pocket, one hand resting on the neck of a hard black cello case standing beside him, skeptical raised eyebrow

characters.name: Kit Alvarez
characters.subject: a wiry young adult man of about twenty, a food-delivery rider, messy dark curls, fluorescent yellow courier jacket with no logo, a phone with a cracked screen inside a clear waterproof pouch on a cord, a power bank wrapped in electrical tape in his other hand, eager smile that does not quite reach his eyes
